description: ai-ecoverse/slicc-jsh#1130: the uncaught caret of an error the program makes inside a throw statement is under that throw, as in Node 22.22.0, also after an object literal, a block, a template's ${} or a string with a ; or } in the statement, and for an error type built through an alias (const or var) or a namespace; an error V8 raises in the statement (o.f(), new Array(-1)) keeps its own column, as does a throw after an earlier statement on the line; from -e, piped stdin, eval code whose source isn't a literal and a CommonJS file (uncaught stderr shown without its frames, which include Node's internal ones)
